verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents adding documents to an existing index, and its first-party sync integrations (Meilisync database sync, Rails ActiveRecord auto-sync) imply incremental propagation of changes rather than full rebuilds. Near-real-time visibility is never documented, and one production user reports indexing of constantly changing records falling hours behind, while others report much-improved indexing speed after batch indexing arrived. missing for 10: documented update and delete semantics, any documented indexing latency or near-real-time guarantee, independent confirmation that changes are searchable quickly under churn.

support.subject: As a developer, document adds, updates, and deletes become searchable in near real time without a full reindex
